<details>
The provided `.install` script for the `9router-bin` package performs standard post-installation and post-upgrade operations typical of AUR packages. It does not exfiltrate data, make network requests, or execute external code. All actions are self-contained, transparent, and limited to the local system configuration necessary for the application to run. There is no evidence of obfuscation, remote command execution, or unauthorized file access. These are expected behaviors for a package that requires per-user configuration on first install.
</details>

The service does not expose unnecessary capabilities or permissions, and there are no signs of obfuscated commands, network exfiltration, or execution of remote code.

The unit file aligns with the expected behavior of a local AI gateway service and does not deviate into malicious or risky territory. All configurations serve the application’s stated purpose without overreaching into system-wide or sensitive operations.
